edges.description: Failure of the fetal contractile apparatus reduces or abolishes fetal movement, entering the movement-dependent branch this entry already models.

nodes.description: In the Amyoplasia pattern, affected limb muscles may be replaced by fatty-fibrous tissue and occur with characteristic limb positions. This human tissue observation applies to Amyoplasia and must not be generalized to every etiologic form of AMC; the causal ordering remains incompletely resolved.

nodes.description: The motor command fails at its origin: the anterior horn motor neurons of the ventral spinal cord are absent or severely depleted, with the peripheral nerve and the muscle secondarily affected. GLE1 encodes the mRNA export mediator whose mutation underlies LCCS1 and LAAHD, the two GLE1-related AMC subtypes, and the autopsy series that delineated LAAHD found a paucity of anterior horn motor neurons in the spinal cord together with neurogenic muscular atrophy in every infant examined. The GLE1 report concludes that mRNA processing is a critical molecular mechanism in motoneuron development and maturation, which is the basis for binding motor neuron differentiation on this node.

nodes.description: The lesion is in brain development or neuronal survival, and reduced fetal movement follows from the central deficit rather than from a motor unit or muscle lesion. In the same 315-family cohort cited on the skeletal muscle branch node, the brain was the second most frequent primary site at 22%. SCYL2 loss of function impairs neuronal cell survival and brain development and produces agenesis of the corpus callosum; biallelic TOR1A produces severe arthrogryposis with developmental delay and dystonic movements; THOC2, otherwise an X-linked intellectual disability gene, produced a recurrent AMC phenotype in two male fetuses of one family.

nodes.description: ERGIC1 is an established cause of congenital arthrogryposis, but the lesion it produces is not localized to a cell type or a process by the reported cases, so this node binds neither. MONDO labels the form neurogenic and the original Israeli Arab kindred was reported as the neuropathic type; the reporting authors propose protein trafficking on the basis of a possible role for ERGIC1 in transport between endoplasmic reticulum and Golgi, which is how they state it. A later family with complete loss of ERGIC1 expression had a relatively mild phenotype and a neurological examination that never pointed towards a neuromuscular disorder, so no myelin, anterior horn cell, or muscle lesion is asserted here.

nodes.description: The motor command fails to reach fetal muscle because the peripheral nerve is not myelinated, while the muscle itself is not the primary lesion. LGI4 is secreted by Schwann cells and regulates peripheral nerve myelination through its receptor ADAM22, and electron microscopy of an affected individual's sciatic nerve showed a lack of myelin. The reporting authors place this finding in an axoglial branch of AMC causation.

nodes.description: The contractile apparatus of fetal skeletal muscle fails, so movement is lost at the effector rather than at its neural command. In a 315-family cohort of undiagnosed AMC, primary involvement of skeletal muscle was the most frequent cause at 40%. The genes bound here act at different points of that apparatus: MYBPC1 encodes a slow skeletal muscle isoform essential for muscle contraction, NEB produces nemaline myopathy with nemaline bodies on muscle specimens, and SYNE1 removes the C-terminal KASH transmembrane domain of nesprin-1, described by its reporting authors as an essential component of the nuclear lamina.
